Container.Name: book-translator-api
Container.Overview: Backend API for Calibre-Web-Automated Book Translator plugin.

Config.Name: LLM Provider
Config.Description: Provider (e.g. local, openai, anthropic, gemini, groq)

Config.Name: Local LLM URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint of your local LLM (only when provider=local). Path is always /v1/chat/completions; set host:port to YOUR server. Ports: vLLM 8000, LM Studio 1234, Ollama 11434. Use the host IP, NOT localhost/127.0.0.1.

Config.Name: Max Concurrent
Config.Description: Simultaneous translation requests. For a slow local model, 1-2 is more stable than 3.

Config.Name: Request Timeout (s)
Config.Description: Seconds before a single translation request is abandoned.
